name: Mux Manascrambler
summary: In Gadgetzan, Mux Manascrambler turns his craft to spirits and occult forces. The goblin engineer studies what others cannot see.

sections.title: A Tinkerer of the Unseen
sections.body:
Near the center of Gadgetzan, Mux Manascrambler works inside a building behind Driz Plunkbow and his clanking Butcherbots. The Steamwheedle Cartel trades in oil, guns, and salvage, but Mux pursues spirits and supernatural anomalies.

He builds strange devices to detect and distill spectral remnants, and to interact with them. His work brings goblin engineering into the unseen world of the dead.

faq.q: Where can I find Mux Manascrambler?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler works in Gadgetzan, in northern Tanaris. Look inside a building near the center of town, behind Driz Plunkbow and the meat-carving Butcherbots.

faq.q: What kind of work does Mux do?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler is an engineer drawn to spirits and unseen forces. He builds devices to reveal spirits, distill ectoplasm, and harness supernatural arcane power.

faq.q: Does Mux belong to a faction?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler belongs to the Steamwheedle Cartel in Gadgetzan. He works independently, keeps commercial neutrality, and aids adventurers from either the Horde or the Alliance.

angles.text: As a goblin engineer, you can use gears and power cells to capture and distill invisible supernatural forces, as Mux does, instead of simply blowing things apart.
